answer: Compare how strictly each identity grades its own suspected cluster versus outsiders. A farm's copies protect each other, so their flag rate inside the circle drops to an onyx-black zero, while honest auditors flag flaws everywhere, scattered across the nebula of submissions. When leniency appears only toward one circle, discount that whole circle's influence. The copies cannot fake strictness without harming each other, and cannot hide leniency, since every grade sits on an ivory, public ledger.
